verses.original: נִפְרָ֑ד יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ לְֽ֭תַאֲוָה יִתְגַּלָּֽע׃ בְּכָל־ תּ֝וּשִׁיָּ֗ה
verses.transliteration: nip̄·rāḏ yə·ḇaq·qêš lə·ṯa·’ă·wāh yiṯ·gal·lā‘ bə·ḵāl tū·šî·yāh
verses.literal: He who isolates himself pursues selfish desires he rebels against all sound judgment

verses.original: כְּ֭סִיל לֹֽא־ יַחְפֹּ֣ץ בִּתְבוּנָ֑ה כִּ֝֗י אִֽם־ בְּהִתְגַּלּ֥וֹת לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kə·sîl lō- yaḥ·pōṣ biṯ·ḇū·nāh kî ’im- bə·hiṯ·gal·lō·wṯ lib·bōw
verses.literal: A fool does not delight in understanding but only . . . in airing his opinions

verses.original: רָ֭שָׁע בְּֽבוֹא־ בּ֑וּז גַם־ בָּ֣א קָל֥וֹן וְֽעִם־ חֶרְפָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rā·šā‘ bə·ḇō·w- būz ḡam- bā qā·lō·wn wə·‘im- ḥer·pāh
verses.literal: With a wicked [man] comes contempt as well . . . and shame is accompanied by disgrace

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י אִ֑ישׁ פִי־ עֲ֭מֻקִּים מַ֣יִם מְק֣וֹר חָכְמָֽה׃ נֹ֝בֵ֗עַ נַ֥חַל
verses.transliteration: diḇ·rê ’îš p̄î- ‘ă·muq·qîm ma·yim mə·qō·wr ḥāḵ·māh nō·ḇê·a‘ na·ḥal
verses.literal: The words of a man’s mouth are deep waters the fountain of wisdom is a bubbling brook

verses.original: שְׂאֵ֣ת פְּנֵי־ רָשָׁ֣ע לֹא־ ט֑וֹב לְהַטּ֥וֹת צַ֝דִּ֗יק בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: śə·’êṯ pə·nê- rā·šā‘ lō- ṭō·wḇ lə·haṭ·ṭō·wṯ ṣad·dîq bam·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Showing partiality vvv to the wicked is not good nor is depriving the innocent of justice

verses.original: כְ֭סִיל שִׂפְתֵ֣י יָבֹ֣אֽוּ בְרִ֑יב וּ֝פִ֗יו יִקְרָֽא׃ לְֽמַהֲלֻמ֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: ḵə·sîl śip̄·ṯê yā·ḇō·’ū ḇə·rîḇ ū·p̄îw yiq·rā lə·ma·hă·lu·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: A fool’s lips bring him strife and his mouth invites a beating

verses.original: כְ֭סִיל פִּֽי־ מְחִתָּה־ ל֑וֹ וּ֝שְׂפָתָ֗יו מוֹקֵ֥שׁ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ḵə·sîl pî- mə·ḥit·tāh- lōw ū·śə·p̄ā·ṯāw mō·w·qêš nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: A fool’s mouth is his ruin and his lips [are] a snare to his soul

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י נִ֭רְגָּן כְּמִֽתְלַהֲמִ֑ים וְ֝הֵ֗ם יָרְד֥וּ חַדְרֵי־ בָֽטֶן׃
verses.transliteration: diḇ·rê nir·gān kə·miṯ·la·hă·mîm wə·hêm yā·rə·ḏū ḥaḏ·rê- ḇā·ṭen
verses.literal: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels that go down into the inmost being . . .

verses.original: גַּ֭ם מִתְרַפֶּ֣ה בִמְלַאכְתּ֑וֹ אָ֥ח ה֝֗וּא לְבַ֣עַל מַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: gam miṯ·rap·peh ḇim·laḵ·tōw ’āḥ hū lə·ḇa·‘al maš·ḥîṯ
verses.literal: Whoever is slothful in his work is brother . . . to him who destroys

verses.original: שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֭ז מִגְדַּל־ צַדִּ֣יק יָר֖וּץ בּֽוֹ־ וְנִשְׂגָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: šêm Yah·weh ‘ōz miḡ·dal- ṣad·dîq yā·rūṣ bōw- wə·niś·gāḇ
verses.literal: The name of the LORD is a strong tower the righteous run to it and are safe

verses.original: עָ֭שִׁיר ה֣וֹן עֻזּ֑וֹ קִרְיַ֣ת נִ֝שְׂגָּבָ֗ה וּכְחוֹמָ֥ה בְּמַשְׂכִּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·šîr hō·wn ‘uz·zōw qir·yaṯ niś·gā·ḇāh ū·ḵə·ḥō·w·māh bə·maś·kî·ṯōw
verses.literal: A rich man’s wealth is his fortified city it is like a high wall in his imagination

verses.original: לִפְנֵי־ שֶׁ֭בֶר אִ֑ישׁ לֵב־ יִגְבַּ֣הּ עֲנָוָֽה׃ וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד
verses.transliteration: lip̄·nê·še- še·b̲er ’îš lêḇ- yiḡ·bah ‘ă·nā·wāh wə·lip̄·nê ḵā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: Before his downfall a man’s heart is proud but humility comes before honor

verses.original: מֵשִׁ֣יב דָּ֭בָר בְּטֶ֣רֶם יִשְׁמָ֑ע הִיא־ אִוֶּ֥לֶת וּכְלִמָּֽה׃ ל֝֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: mê·šîḇ dā·ḇār bə·ṭe·rem yiš·mā‘ hî- ’iw·we·leṯ ū·ḵə·lim·māh lōw
verses.literal: He who answers a matter before he hears [it] this [is] folly and disgrace to him

verses.original: רֽוּחַ־ אִ֭ישׁ יְכַלְכֵּ֣ל מַחֲלֵ֑הוּ מִ֣י יִשָּׂאֶֽנָּה׃ נְ֝כֵאָ֗ה וְר֥וּחַ
verses.transliteration: rū·aḥ- ’îš yə·ḵal·kêl ma·ḥă·lê·hū mî yiś·śā·’en·nāh nə·ḵê·’āh wə·rū·aḥ
verses.literal: The spirit of a man can endure his sickness but who can survive a broken spirit

verses.original: לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן יִקְנֶה־ דָּ֑עַת וְאֹ֥זֶן חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים תְּבַקֶּשׁ־ דָּֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: lêḇ nā·ḇō·wn yiq·neh- dā·‘aṯ wə·’ō·zen ḥă·ḵā·mîm tə·ḇaq·qeš- dā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge and the ear of the wise seeks it out

verses.original: אָ֭דָם מַתָּ֣ן יַרְחִ֣יב ל֑וֹ יַנְחֶֽנּוּ׃ וְלִפְנֵ֖י גְדֹלִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām mat·tān yar·ḥîḇ lōw yan·ḥen·nū wə·lip̄·nê ḡə·ḏō·lîm
verses.literal: A man’s gift opens doors for him and brings him before great men

verses.original: הָרִאשׁ֣וֹן בְּרִיב֑וֹ צַדִּ֣יק רֵ֝עֵ֗הוּ יָבֹא וַחֲקָרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ri·šō·wn bə·rî·ḇōw ṣad·dîq yå̄·ḇō wa·ḥă·qā·rōw
verses.literal: The first to state his case seems right until another comes and cross-examines him

verses.original: הַגּוֹרָ֑ל וּבֵ֖ין יַשְׁבִּ֣ית מִ֭דְיָנִים יַפְרִֽיד׃ עֲצוּמִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: hag·gō·w·rāl ū·ḇên yaš·bîṯ miḏ·yā·nîm yap̄·rîḏ ‘ă·ṣū·mîm
verses.literal: Casting the lot . . . ends quarrels and separates strong opponents

verses.original: נִפְשָׁ֥ע אָ֗ח עֹ֑ז מִקִּרְיַת־ וּמְדוֹנִים כִּבְרִ֥יחַ אַרְמֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: nip̄·šā‘ ’āḥ ‘ōz miq·qir·yaṯ- ū·mə·ḏō·nīm kiḇ·rî·aḥ ’ar·mō·wn
verses.literal: An offended brother [is harder to win] than a fortified city and disputes are like the bars of a castle

verses.original: מִפְּרִ֣י פִי־ אִ֭ישׁ בִּטְנ֑וֹ תִּשְׂבַּ֣ע תְּבוּאַ֖ת שְׂפָתָ֣יו יִשְׂבָּֽע׃
verses.transliteration: mip·pə·rî p̄î- ’îš biṭ·nōw tiś·ba‘ tə·ḇū·’aṯ śə·p̄ā·ṯāw yiś·bā‘
verses.literal: From the fruit of his mouth a man’s belly is filled with the harvest from his lips he is satisfied

verses.original: וְ֭חַיִּים מָ֣וֶת בְּיַד־ לָשׁ֑וֹן וְ֝אֹהֲבֶ֗יהָ יֹאכַ֥ל פִּרְיָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥay·yîm mā·weṯ bə·yaḏ- lā·šō·wn wə·’ō·hă·ḇe·hā yō·ḵal pir·yāh
verses.literal: Life and death are in the power of the tongue and those who love [it] will eat its fruit

verses.original: מָצָ֣א אִ֭שָּׁה מָ֣צָא ט֑וֹב וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mā·ṣā ’iš·šāh mā·ṣā ṭō·wḇ way·yā·p̄eq rā·ṣō·wn Yah·weh
verses.literal: He who finds a wife finds a good thing and obtains favor from the LORD

verses.original: רָ֑שׁ תַּחֲנוּנִ֥ים יְדַבֶּר־ וְ֝עָשִׁ֗יר יַעֲנֶ֥ה עַזּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: rāš ta·ḥă·nū·nîm yə·ḏab·ber- wə·‘ā·šîr ya·‘ă·neh ‘az·zō·wṯ
verses.literal: The poor man pleads for mercy . . . but the rich man answers harshly

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ רֵ֭עִים לְהִתְרֹעֵ֑עַ וְיֵ֥שׁ אֹ֝הֵ֗ב דָּבֵ֥ק מֵאָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš rê·‘îm lə·hiṯ·rō·‘ê·a‘ wə·yêš ’ō·hêḇ dā·ḇêq mê·’āḥ
verses.literal: A man of many companions may come to ruin but there is a friend who stays closer than a brother
